title: 小团队文件共享 · 待确认设计
goal: Confirm a Node.js file-sharing application with queued download preparation and an independent announcement board before implementing behavior.

sources.text: 我想用 Node.js 做一个小团队文件共享应用：上传文件，分享给同事，也能撤销共享；下载可以排队准备，准备好后在页面领取。另外有一个独立的公告板。我是开发者，希望看清权限和后台任务的实际运行。应用沿用自身的业务逻辑，VibeLens 用 observe 模式。我希望先确认业务、状态和规则图，再开始实现。不清楚的地方先问我。用中文交流，源码和注释用英文。

sources.text: Candidate for discussion only: collection rechecks current file access and task identity; revoked recipients cannot collect. This is not an accepted rule.

sources.text: Candidate for discussion only: team membership permits announcement publication and reading; announcement operations are independent of file permissions.

sources.text:
文件权限是否按这个规则：上传者指定具体同事；只有上传者可以分享或撤销；接收人只能查看、申请下载，不能继续转分享？
同事申请下载后、领取前，共享被撤销时应怎样处理？
独立公告板的权限是什么：谁可以发布、谁可以阅读？
sources.locator: Current chat: first asynchronous question batch delivered through request_user_input_async; delivery acknowledgement is not an answer

sources.text:
文件权限按这个规则。上传者自己和被指定的同事能查看、下载，其他同事看不到；接收人不能再转分享。

下载任务提交时已经获准，就让这一单继续准备并领取，后来撤销共享也不影响这一单。撤销以后不能再创建新的下载任务。

公告板只给登录同事看。指定一个公告编辑员可以发布、修改和删除自己的公告；这个角色不增加管理别人文件的权限。
sources.locator: Current chat: user answer forwarded from source chat 01a1439a-dceb-7ba2-bada-546619caf220, 2026-11-19

sources.text:
存储建议使用 SQLite 保存成员、文件元数据、共享关系、任务和公告，文件内容放项目本地目录，部署时无需另起数据库服务。你接受这个选择，还是使用 PostgreSQL 等已有数据库？
准备好的下载任务领取后，是否允许同一个申请人再次领取这一单？这会决定任务是否进入不可再次领取的终态。
sources.locator: Current chat: second asynchronous question batch delivered through request_user_input_async; awaiting actual answers

sources.text: 用 SQLite，文件就放在项目本地目录。准备好以后，同一个申请人可以重复领取这一单，不需要因为领取过一次就把它关掉。

networks.title: 文件共享
networks.trigger: 成员上传文件或调整共享
networks.outcome: 仅上传者和当前被指定同事能查看文件、申请下载；仅上传者能分享和撤销。

nodes.label: 上传文件
nodes.meaning: Store a new file and retain its uploader identity.

nodes.label: 分享给同事
nodes.meaning: The uploader grants file access to a named colleague; recipients cannot re-share.

nodes.label: 撤销共享
nodes.meaning: The uploader deactivates a recipient grant, preventing file visibility and new download requests for that colleague.

nodes.label: 查看文件
nodes.meaning: Only the uploader or a currently designated recipient may view file metadata. Other colleagues cannot discover the file.

networks.title: 下载准备与领取
networks.trigger: 成员为一个文件申请准备下载
networks.outcome: 提交时获准的任务继续准备；申请人可重复领取；撤销只拒绝新任务。

nodes.label: 申请下载
nodes.meaning: Check current file access at submission, allocate a task, and commit its requester identity and submission authorization.

nodes.label: 后台准备
nodes.meaning: The application worker starts preparation for one queued task.

nodes.label: 准备完成
nodes.meaning: Mark the same task ready after the artifact is available.

nodes.label: 页面领取
nodes.meaning: The same authenticated requester may repeatedly collect the ready task authorized at submission. Share revocation never invalidates an already authorized task. Collection does not close or consume it.

edges.label: 同一申请人可重复领取

networks.title: 独立公告板
networks.trigger: 发布公告或打开公告板
networks.outcome: 登录同事阅读公告；指定编辑员发布、修改和删除自己的公告；公告角色不改变文件权限。

nodes.label: 发布公告
nodes.meaning: The designated announcement editor may publish their own announcement.

nodes.label: 阅读公告
nodes.meaning: Authenticated colleagues may read published announcements without file access.

nodes.label: 修改自己的公告
nodes.meaning: An authenticated announcement editor may edit only an announcement they authored.

nodes.label: 删除自己的公告
nodes.meaning: An authenticated announcement editor may delete only an announcement they authored.

persist_authorized_task.meaning: Persist this task and its submission-time authorization independently of later grant revocation.
persist_authorized_task.completion: Application transaction commits the queued task and its authorization together.

state.reason: Creates an immutable file object; no subsequent file lifecycle was requested.

rules.reason: Internal worker step processes a task already authorized at submission; no new user authorization occurs.
Internal worker completion preserves the existing task authorization.

obligations.meaning: Represent download requests, queued preparation and page collection.
Give each file/recipient grant its own state identity.
Give each download preparation request its own task identity.
Confirm and retain the manage_share rule.
Confirm and retain the request_download rule.
Confirm and retain the collect_download rule.
Confirm and retain the publish_announcement rule.
Confirm and retain the read_announcements rule.
Task state belongs to a task instance, independently of the file and grant.
Sharing status belongs to each recipient grant.
Keep the announcement lifecycle independent of files and download tasks.
Each announcement has its own identity and author.
Announcement editors may modify/delete only their own announcement.
Submission authorization is persisted with the task at a real commit boundary.

decisions.question: 文件权限是否按这个规则：上传者指定具体同事；只有上传者可以分享或撤销；接收人只能查看、申请下载，不能继续转分享？
decisions.why: Determines grant ownership and whether recipients may manage sharing.

routing.trigger: The request leaves this meaning or implementation choice unspecified.

resolution.text: Only the uploader manages grants; uploader and designated recipients may view/download; recipients cannot re-share.

decisions.question: 同事申请下载后、领取前，共享被撤销时应怎样处理？
decisions.why: Determines when file permission facts are read and whether an existing ready task survives revocation.

routing.trigger: The request leaves this meaning or implementation choice unspecified.

resolution.text: Authorization is committed at task submission. The approved task remains preparable and collectible after share revocation; new task creation is denied.

decisions.question: 独立公告板的权限是什么：谁可以发布、谁可以阅读？
decisions.why: Determines the independent publication and readership predicates.

routing.trigger: The request leaves this meaning or implementation choice unspecified.

resolution.text: Authenticated colleagues read announcements. A designated editor publishes, edits and deletes only their own announcements. This role grants no file management rights.

decisions.question: 成员通过用户名和密码登录，还是仅切换演示身份？
decisions.why: Permission observations require an unambiguous actor identity.

routing.trigger: The request leaves this meaning or implementation choice unspecified.

resolution.text: The user explicitly requires logged-in colleagues, establishing authenticated actor identity.

decisions.question: 是否用 SQLite 保存成员、文件元数据、共享关系、下载任务和公告，文件内容放项目本地目录？
decisions.why: SQLite avoids a separate server for this small local application; PostgreSQL better fits a separately deployed shared database.

routing.trigger: The request leaves this meaning or implementation choice unspecified.

resolution.text: Use SQLite and project-local file storage.

decisions.question: 准备好的下载任务领取后，是否允许同一个申请人再次领取这一单？
decisions.why: Determines whether collection reads ready state or consumes the task into a terminal state.

routing.trigger: Page collection is requested but repeat collection is unspecified.

resolution.text: The same requester may collect the same ready task repeatedly; collection does not close the task.
